registered_addition_groups.owner: M3-B C2 phone prediction-error witness preflight
registered_addition_groups.rationale: These findings are bounded canonical SHA-256 review material and local collection/schema operations for an operator-produced phone witness. The encode call hashes canonical witness material, set() only validates strictly increasing snapshot ticks, and the subscript assignment adds the final public-review digest to a newly constructed local mapping. They install no runtime hook, register no attestation or verifier, retain no observation, mutate no live affect/goal/registry owner state, start no observation window, and grant no M3 or cutover authority.

registered_addition_groups.owner: M3-B C2 operator phone witness CLI
registered_addition_groups.rationale: These operations are confined to the operator witness helper: repository-root sys.path bootstrap, an in-memory two-snapshot list, and explicit writes to an operator-selected private directory that is required to resolve outside the repository with private permissions. The writes preserve recalculable raw witness material in the private companion and a public-safe digest record; they do not touch EVE persistence, register production trust, retain a real observation through the M3-B sink, or change runtime/cutover authority.
